title: Finite-size mean bias of the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick free energy
abstract: Formalization of a fixed-temperature N^(-7/10) bound for the finite-size mean bias of the zero-field Sherrington-Kirkpatrick model with independent standard Gaussian couplings and the unnormalized partition function. For every beta > 1, a positive constant depending on beta bounds the nonnegative pressure gap for every integer N >= 2. The selected results also establish the thermodynamic limit for beta > 0, the corresponding free-energy-density and expected log-partition corrections, a positive exponent saving over 2/3, and a full-sequence little-o improvement. The independently readable interface defines the limiting pressure by a thermodynamic limit; Solution identifies it with the all-probability-profile Parisi variational value.
